in_marathi.name: Vishu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Wealth and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vishu is the name of the Hindu deity Vishnu in his form as the preserver and protector of the universe. The name Vishu is derived from the Sanskrit word vish, which means 'all-pervading'. Vishu is believed to bring prosperity and wealth to those who call upon him.
